{
  "fixed_xml": "<ITEM>In <PUBLISHER>Herrn Johan Pistorischen Buchdruckerey zu St. Elßbethen</PUBLISHER> ist sowohl in Teütscher als Frantzösischer Sprach zu haben, <BIBL><TITLE>die Antwort auf das wider Ihro Kayserl. Majestät ausgegebene Spannische Manifest</TITLE>, worinnen enthalten, was Ihro Cathol. Majest. bewogen dem Kayser den Krieg anzukünden; aus obiger Antwort aber dessen trifftige Widerlegung zu sehen ist</BIBL>, das Stuck à <PRIZE>6. xr.</PRIZE></ITEM>",
  "number_of_fixes": 8,
  "explanation": "1) Structural error: the <TITLE> element was closed twice. The first </TITLE> correctly ends the title 'die Antwort auf das ... Spannische Manifest'. The second </TITLE> after 'zu sehen ist' had no matching opening tag, so I replaced it with the closing tag </BIBL>. Otherwise <BIBL> was never closed and the XML was not well-formed. 2) Character-encoding corruption (UTF-8 text mis-decoded as MacRoman, which produced sequences like '√º') was repaired in six places: 'Elßbethen' (ß), 'Teütscher' (ü), 'Frantzösischer' (ö), 'Majestät' (ä), 'anzukünden' (ü) and 'à' (in 'das Stuck à 6 xr.'). 3) Added a semantic <PUBLISHER> tag around the printing house ('Herrn Johan Pistorischen Buchdruckerey zu St. Elßbethen'), since the other elements (BIBL, TITLE, PRIZE) already mark up the bibliographic and price information. The historical spellings (Teütscher, Frantzösischer, Spannische, trifftige, Stuck) were left as they are, because they are original orthography and not errors."
}

The historical spellings (Teütscher, Frantzösischer, Spannische, trifftige, Stuck) were left as they are, because they are original orthography and not errors.
